description: This file defines a Flutter widget `FallbackMarkerIcon` that displays a custom silhouette shape (either Stark-like or Lannister-like) using Canvas drawing via a `CustomPainter`. It handles the visual representation of a fallback icon when an asset isn't loaded.

classes.name: FallbackMarkerIcon
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a silhouette-like shape based on parameters.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a widget tree that includes a CustomPaint widget for drawing the silhouette.

classes.name: _MarkerPainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter that draws either a Stark or Lannister themed shape based on the isStark flag.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Draws the silhouette shape on the canvas depending on the shape type.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines when to repaint based on changes in color or shape type.

methods.name: FallbackMarkerIcon
methods.description: Constructor for creating the fallback marker icon widget.
